What it Measures: The objective quality of the photo before the AI ever sees it
How We Calculate It:
Blur Penalty (Variance of Laplacian)
Lighting Penalty (Brightness/Contrast limits)
Framing Penalty (Subject centering)
(Total: 100 - Penalties)
Expected Result / Output:
A score from 0 to 100.
Real-time audio feedback to the user (e.g., 'Frame too blurry, hold steady').

What it Measures: How much your app's guidance actually improves the AI's success rate
How We Calculate It:
Runs the VQA model on Unguided (bad) vs Guided (good) photos.
Checks if the AI's confidence is above the threshold (e.g., 80%) to count as 'Answerable'.
Expected Result / Output:
+X% Delta Improvement.
Proves that filtering bad photos drastically reduces the AI's failure/hallucination rate.

What it Measures: How fast and easy it is for a visually impaired user to operate the app
How We Calculate It:
Timer: Tracks seconds from opening the camera to hearing 'Good Frame Detected'.
AUS: Automatically scores the standard 10-question Accessible Usability Scale.
Expected Result / Output:
Average Task Time (seconds).
AUS Score (0 to 100, where >68 is considered highly usable).
